source.solution: Let $x=A E / E C$. By Menelaus's theorem applied to triangle $A B E$ and line $C X F$, $$1=\frac{A F}{F B} \cdot \frac{B X}{X E} \cdot \frac{E C}{C A}=\frac{x^{2}}{x+1}$$ Thus, $x^{2}=x+1$, and $x$ must be positive, so $x=(1+\sqrt{5}) / 2$. Now apply Menelaus to triangle $A C F$ and line $B X E$, obtaining $$1=\frac{A E}{E C} \cdot \frac{C X}{X F} \cdot \frac{F B}{B A}=\frac{C X}{X F} \cdot \frac{x}{x^{2}+1}$$ so $C X / X F=\left(x^{2}+1\right) / x=\left(2 x^{2}-x\right) / x=2 x-1=\sqrt{5}$.
